title: Stuck in the Turing Matrix: Inauthenticity, Deception and the Social Life of Al
reasoning: The paper's central framework, the 'Turing Matrix,' is built on the concepts of authenticity and deception, which are fundamentally ethical and moral dimensions of human-AI interaction.
